scope.operation: Conservatively classify rooted ACIS projection snapshots as having known gaps when typed geometry rows disagree with their retained source graph-link groups.
invariants: vertex, edge, and face source rows resolve to the corresponding source-ordered graphLinks group with expected pointer count and sequential pointer ordinals
vertex pointNodeIndex equals the exact source pointer target at ordinal 2
edge start/end vertex, coedge, and curve node identities equal exact source pointer targets at ordinals 1 through 4
face shell, first-loop, and surface identities equal exact source pointer targets at ordinals 3, 2, and 5
scope.semanticLimit: Projection/census consistency only. The retained graphLinks are not an independent source-format oracle and do not establish source completeness, B-rep validity, native ACIS semantics, or consumer acceptance.
